t: This bronze statue in Belgrave Square shows José de San Martín, the Argentine general and independence leader. It was unveiled on the second of November 1994 by Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, accompanied by the Argentine Ambassador, Mario Cámpora. The sculptor was the Argentinian artist Juan Carlos Ferraro, who lived from 1917 to 2004. San Martín himself lived from 1778 to 1850, so this is a modern tribute to a figure from the early nineteenth century, placed here by his own country.
